name: Innocent Forest -Hi no Tori-
source:
"When you step into this forest, you lose one memory…"
Innocent Forest is fantasy story about a girl called Luclei and the memories of her visitors.
The forest of lost memories: a place where they say you can forget one painful occurrence.
Kei, a young man lost in the forest, encounters a mysterious girl named Luclei, who lives among the woods and gathers a flock of birds. 
It is through these birds the past, present and future of lost memories unfolds.

[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/929170/Innocent_Forest_The_Bird_of_Light/] Steam[/url]]

A virtual reality adaptation of a short story from the "[url=http://lucray.cocotte.jp/inst/]Innocent Forest[/url]" series written by Yomino Machiko. "Hi no Tori" corresponds to the 1st episode published in the 1st volume.
translation:
“当你踏入这片森林，你就会失去一段记忆……”
《无辜森林》讲述了一个名叫露克莱的女孩和她的访客的回忆的奇幻故事。
失去记忆的森林：据说在这里你可以忘记一件痛苦的事情。
迷失在森林中的年轻人凯遇到了一位名叫露克莱的神秘女孩，她住在树林里，聚集了一群鸟。
正是通过这些鸟，失落记忆的过去、现在和未来得以展现。

[编辑自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/929170/Innocent_Forest_The_Bird_of_Light/] Steam[/url]]

虚拟现实改编自读野町子所著的“[url=http://lucray.cocotte.jp/inst/]Innocent Forest[/url]”系列短篇小说。《Hi no Tori》对应第1卷第1话。
